title: v25.0.3: Buildable finite evidence for the kernel-checked bounded gap-3 search through B = 1,000,000
description: Lean 4.12.0 proves that no natural numbers A and B with B <= 1,000,000 satisfy A^4 + B^4 = (B+3)^13. This release registers the existing nested BealLevel26Foundations.FiniteEvidence and BealLevel26Foundations.M3_Explicit modules as Lake targets without changing their proofs. Ten modular masks have kernel-checked soundness proofs; 2,000 separately compiled 500-value certificates cover B < 1,000,000, and the inclusive endpoint is checked separately. The bounded theorem uses only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. An exact-integer external checkpoint is independent evidence and is not a proof input. BealFinal.Main still takes conditional mathematical data as input. This does not prove the general Beal conjecture or discharge the remaining level-26 mathematical hypotheses. Methodology and build instructions: docs/FoundationsIntegratedV25_0_2.md.
